items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: We have Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis’s tenor sax and I went out to his family’s house in Las Vegas

ctx.x: We have that. We have Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis’s tenor sax and I went out to his family’s house in Las Vegas, all his things. So his reeds and his matchbook covers from Birdland, and the album that his mother made when he was a kid. We have the Savory Collection which are unissued recordings going back to the 1930s and 40s. We have a handful of collections like that that are very very special.
So I’m going to make a proposal that when I do Part Two with you I’ll come down and we’ll do it there in the aura would be there and I’ll get to see your things.
